_note: 學習路徑內容建置第6批 #4／6：方向/移動介系詞 prepositions of direction（eng.t_mid.prep.direction，會考級／中階）。into＝進到裡面；onto＝到表面/上面；through＝穿過封閉空間（隧道/森林）；across＝橫越平面或線（馬路/河/橋）；along＝沿著長條狀（路/河邊/海灘）。誘答為語意明顯不符該中文情境的介系詞；中文清楚界定意圖以鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix pdr_）。

units.can_do: 我能依移動的樣子選對方向介系詞——into（進到裡面）、onto（到表面/上面）、through（穿過封閉空間）、across（橫越平面/線）、along（沿著長條狀東西走）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'into' shows movement to the inside of an enclosed space: The cat ran into the house.
claims.verification_ref: into＝移動進到裡面；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'onto' shows movement to the top or surface of something: The cat jumped onto the table.
claims.verification_ref: onto＝移動到表面/上面；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'through' shows movement from one end to the other of an enclosed space such as a tunnel or a forest: The train went through the tunnel.
claims.verification_ref: through＝穿過封閉空間（隧道/森林）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'across' shows movement from one side to the other of a flat area or a line such as a street, a river, or a bridge: She walked across the street.
claims.verification_ref: across＝橫越平面/線（馬路/河/橋）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'along' shows movement following the length of something long such as a road, a river, or a beach: We walked along the beach.
claims.verification_ref: along＝沿著長條狀東西的長邊走；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Prepositions of direction tell us which way something moves. 'into' means moving from outside to the inside of an enclosed space; 'onto' means moving to the surface or top of something. Picture the direction of the movement and you can pick the right word.
teach.zh_hint: 方向／移動介系詞告訴我們「往哪裡移動」。into＝從外面移動到「裡面」（封閉空間）；onto＝移動到「表面或上面」。想像動作的方向，就能選對。

teach.body: The dog ran into the house and jumped onto the sofa.
teach.zh_hint: 狗跑進屋裡，跳到沙發上。into＝進到裡面、onto＝到表面上。

teach.body: 'through' means moving across the inside of an enclosed space (a tunnel, a forest, a crowd) from one end to the other. 'across' means moving over a flat area or a line (a street, a river, a bridge) from one side to the other.
teach.zh_hint: through＝「穿過」封閉空間（隧道、森林、人群），從一端到另一端；across＝「橫越」平面或線（馬路、河、橋），從一邊到另一邊。

teach.body: We drove through the tunnel and then walked across the bridge.
teach.zh_hint: 我們開車穿過隧道，然後走過那座橋。through＝穿過封閉、across＝橫越。

teach.body: 'along' means moving by the length of something long (a road, a riverside, a beach), following its long edge.
teach.zh_hint: along＝「沿著」長條狀的東西（路、河邊、海灘）走它的長邊。

teach.body: They rode their bikes along the river.
teach.zh_hint: 他們沿著河邊騎腳踏車。along＝沿著長邊。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞：She opened the door and walked ____ the room.（她打開門，走進房間裡面）

distractor_rationales.onto: onto 是「到表面/上面」（如跳到桌上）；房間是空間，走「進去裡面」用 into。
distractor_rationales.along: along 是「沿著長邊走」（如沿著路）；走進房間裡面用 into。
distractor_rationales.off: off 是「離開/下來」；走進房間裡面方向相反，用 into。

practice.feedback: 移動到封閉空間「裡面」用 into：She walked into the room。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞：The cat jumped ____ the table to reach the food.（貓跳到桌子上面）

distractor_rationales.into: into 是「進到裡面」；跳到桌子「上面（表面）」用 onto。
distractor_rationales.through: through 是「穿過封閉空間」；跳到桌面用 onto。
distractor_rationales.along: along 是「沿著長邊走」；跳到桌面上用 onto。

practice.feedback: 移動到表面/上面用 onto：The cat jumped onto the table。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞：The train went ____ a long tunnel under the mountain.（火車穿過山底下一條長隧道）

distractor_rationales.across: across 是「橫越」平面或線（馬路/橋）；在隧道內部從一端穿到另一端用 through。
distractor_rationales.onto: onto 是「到表面上面」；穿過隧道用 through。
distractor_rationales.into: into 只表示「進到裡面」（沒出來）；火車「穿過整條隧道」到另一端用 through。

practice.feedback: 穿過封閉空間（隧道）從一端到另一端用 through：The train went through the tunnel。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞：Be careful when you walk ____ the busy street.（你過馬路時要小心——從這一邊走到另一邊）

distractor_rationales.into: into 是「走進某個空間裡面」；從馬路這邊橫越到另一邊用 across。
distractor_rationales.onto: onto 是「到表面上面」；橫越馬路用 across。
distractor_rationales.through: through 是「穿過封閉空間」（隧道/森林）；橫越開放的馬路（平面/線）用 across。

practice.feedback: 橫越平面或線（馬路）從一邊到另一邊用 across：walk across the street。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞：We rode our bikes ____ the river and enjoyed the view.（我們沿著河邊騎腳踏車）

distractor_rationales.across: across 是「橫越」到河的「另一邊」（需過橋/游泳）；沿著河邊走它的長邊用 along。
distractor_rationales.into: into 是「進到…裡面」（如 into the river＝進到水裡）；沿著河邊用 along。
distractor_rationales.onto: onto 是「到表面上面」；沿著河邊的長邊騎用 along。

practice.feedback: 沿著長條狀東西（河邊）的長邊走用 along：rode along the river。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: We walked along the beach and then ran into the cold water.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：along（沿著海灘）和 into（進到水裡）兩個介系詞有沒有選對，and then 有沒有漏，句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。兩句句尾下收；介系詞（onto／into／through／across）輕讀，動詞稍清楚。

lines.text: The dog jumped onto the bed and ran into the kitchen.
lines.intonation: 平穩、jumped／ran 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: We drove through the tunnel and across the bridge.
lines.intonation: 平穩、through／across 稍強調、句尾下收
